releases.notes:
**New**
- Now works on client-side as well, nearby station/depot landmarks will also show without the server.

**Changes**
- The built-in config command has been moved into a [separate, more universal mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/qomc), which also provides a config command for Surveyor Map Framework itself and the alike.
- Now supports Surveyor Map Framework **v1.2**.

**Fixes**
- Fix crash on startup when no other surveyor addons that utilize the landmark feature is installed.

releases.notes:
**Breaking Change**
- The config format has been changed to be similar to surveyor's config.
- - New location: `config/mtrsurveyor.toml`
- - Config will not be migrated, players may need to reconfigure the mod. (Rest assured, this will likely be a one-off migration!)
- Now configurable with [McQoy](https://modrinth.com/mod/mcqoy) for those who prefer a Config GUI.

**Addition / Changes**
- Add support for stylized marker symbols in [Antique Atlas 4 (AA4)](https://modrinth.com/mod/antique-atlas-4) when installed in client.
- Landmarks will now automatically sync whenever a config has been changed.
- Landmark ID has been slightly altered in order to provide distinct symbols in AA4, *this should be transparent to most players as landmarks are automatically re-synced on launch.*
- **Config:**
- - The `autoSync` option has been removed in favor of an `enabled`/`disabled` system, ensuring the landmarks should always be in-sync.
- - - This replaces `/mtrsurveyor clearLandmarks`. Running `/mtrsurveyor config enabled false` will turn off auto-sync and clear landmarks at the same time. (Useful for mod uninstallation!)
- - The `showStationWithNoRoute` option has been renamed to `showEmptyStation`. They serve the same function otherwise.
